title: Technology Delivery Lead
description:
**Job Description**
 Role Overview We are looking for a Technology Delivery Lead to own the end\-to\-end delivery of technology outcomes across the full product and project lifecycle. The role will involve leading cross\-functional teams, managing dependencies, risks, and delivery plans, ensuring governance compliance, overseeing financials, and engaging with stakeholders across product, technology, and business functions. The Technology Delivery Lead will work across Agile, Product Management, and traditional project delivery practices to ensure technology deliverables are planned, governed, and delivered in a safe, predictable, and value\-focused manner. Key Responsibilities Own end\-to\-end IT delivery across agreed scope, budget, quality, and timelines. Apply Agile, Product Management, and traditional delivery principles as appropriate to the delivery context. Plan, coordinate, and control delivery activities across teams, suppliers, and business functions. Manage delivery dependencies, risks, issues, and critical paths. Create and maintain delivery plans, product roadmaps, resource forecasts, budgets, success criteria, and milestone tracking. Ensure clear roles and responsibilities across Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Architecture and Engineering teams, and business stakeholders within a matrix environment. Support and contribute to business case development in alignment with governance requirements and value delivery expectations. Manage financial forecasting and reporting, including benefits realisation and cost optimisation opportunities. Lead, motivate, and support project and product teams while promoting collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement. Ensure alignment with IT governance, change frameworks, and Agile and Product Portfolio/Program processes. Identify opportunities to reduce cost, improve performance, and enhance customer outcomes throughout the delivery lifecycle. Manage internal teams, external vendors, and third parties, ensuring obligations are met and value is delivered. Ensure delivery complies with agreed processes and standards and supports effective alignment between product, technology, and business stakeholders. Ensure change is effectively transitioned into operations. Proactively escalate risks, issues, and exceptions and ensure timely resolution through appropriate change control processes. Facilitate steering committees, Agile ceremonies, and delivery forums to maintain transparency and stakeholder alignment. Champion continuous improvement across IT Change and Product communities. Promote Agile metrics including velocity, predictability, and flow. Required Skills \& Experience Project \& Product Delivery Strong project and product delivery skills within complex, matrix organisations. Proven experience delivering complex IT projects and/or product increments. Strong expertise in: Delivery planning Dependency management Risk and issue management Delivery reporting Milestone tracking Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously. Experience working within both traditional and large\-scale Agile frameworks. Agile \& Product Management Deep understanding of the Agile mindset and scaled delivery models. Experience collaborating with: Product Managers Product Owners Scrum Masters RTEs Agile Teams Experience building product roadmaps, identifying value streams, and prioritising product increments. Knowledge of Agile metrics, including: Velocity PI Predictability Flow Efficiency Lead Time Leadership \& Stakeholder Management Strong leadership skills with experience motivating cross\-functional teams. Experience leading cross\-functional and virtual teams within a matrix organisation. Excellent communication and negotiation capabilities. Ability to influence senior stakeholders and steering committees. Strong stakeholder engagement and alignment capabilities. Experience managing vendors and third parties. Financial Management \& Governance Experience managing budgets, financials, and forecasts. Competence in budgeting, financial forecasting, and financial reporting. Understanding of governance frameworks, regulatory requirements, and organisational controls. Experience supporting business case development and benefits realisation. Technical Awareness Awareness of: Enterprise IT systems Integration Infrastructure Cloud Digital solutions Ability to engage with technical teams to understand constraints and propose workable solutions. Desirable Skills \& Experience Previous experience in digital, integration, infrastructure, or application delivery. Familiarity with Workday, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools. Behavioural Competencies Customer\-Centric: Focused on delivering high\-quality business value. Agile Leadership: Encourages innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning. Collaborative: Builds trust and supports effective collaboration across teams and departments. Accountable: Takes ownership of delivery outcomes and makes informed decisions. Transparent: Maintains clear and consistent communication with stakeholders. Resilient \& Adaptable: Able to operate effectively in fast\-moving and ambiguous environments.

title: Digitial Product Management Sr Analyst
description:
**Overview**
 One of PepsiCo’s priorities focus areas in the digital strategy is Sales Effectives. Sales Effectiveness (SE) exists to improve front line performance of daily tasks, increasing sales through prescriptive recommendations for prospecting, selling, servicing, and merchandising. Within SE, there are several digital products being developed. Within SE, there are several digital products being developed. This position is to support Product AiQ and BluePrint. Account IQ will create a common interface for our businesses to drive effectiveness of our Key Account Managers. and BluePrint is an application to enable digital transformation of our AFH Partners. The position of Product Sr. Analyst, AiQ will orchestrate all aspects of product management ranging from supporting the roadmap while also ensuring unified understanding and delivery across teams (architecture, data foundation, service design, operations) and also overseeing the global expansion. This product will serve as the foundational capability and product for our SE transformation to unlock business value via a unified solution.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Product Ownership
   

  

* Serve as a subject matter expert of our current \& planned AiQ \& BluePrint capabilities
* Facilitate meetings with cross\-functional business and technical teams to gather product requirements and business use cases
* Prioritize and create clear user stories and acceptance criteria day\-by\-day and manage progress through agile ceremonies by working with leads, developers, and scrum masters
* Define, create, and manage the product backlog through weekly backlog sessions
* Manage QA by accepting the completed user stories to make sure the work fulfills the criteria
* Provide feedback at demos related to product delivery, usability, and functionality, and escalate any discrepancies to Product Manager to ensure business goals are met
* Outline PI Objectives and lead validation efforts with all stakeholders; co\-lead PI planning
* In partnership with the Scrum Master, identify risks and concerns for product delivery as related to individual teams
* Surface blockers and provide recommended solutions based on trade\-offs to optimize customer experience, and time\-to\-market
* Clearly communicate goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to internal stakeholders and remote teams
* Update Product Documentation as necessary including technical requirements, roadmaps, feature availability, and metadata management


 Compensation and Benefits:
   

  

* Location, confirmed job\-related skills, experience, and education will be considered in setting actual starting salary. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process.
* Bonus based on performance and eligibility target payout is 8% of annual salary paid out annually.
* Paid time off subject to eligibility, including paid parental leave, vacation, sick, and bereavement.
* In addition to salary, PepsiCo offers a comprehensive benefits package to support our employees and their families, subject to elections and eligibility: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Health, and Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Insurance (Accident, Group Legal, Life), Defined Contribution Retirement Plan.


**Qualifications**
* BA or MBA in Business Management or a related field
* 9\+ years of work experience as a Product Analyst / Owner bringing software products to market
* Agile methodology experience from defining user stories, to sizing, Sprint Planning and Sprint Execution to go live and hyper care
* Strong communicator with excellent people skills to interact with various teams inside the company, clients, and vendors.
* Metrics\-driven: strong analytical and synthesis skills (both qualitative \& quantitative), including the ability to absorb and process large amounts of data into actionable information
* Undergraduate degree required, ideally in technical or process focused areas
* Business curiosity via related leadership experience

description:
**Associate Senior Service Delivery Officer (Regional Partner \& Technology Advocate)**
 Job \#: req38471
   

  

 Organization: World Bank
   

  

 Sector: Information Technology
   

  

 Grade: GG

 Recruitment Type: Local Recruitment
   

  

 Location: New Delhi,India
   

  

 Required Language(s): English
   

  

**Preferred Language(s)**
 Closing Date: 10/12/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
   

  

**Description**
 At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1\.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data\-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who\-we\-are/ibrd
   

  

**ITS Vice Presidency Context**
 The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150\+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload\=9\&v\=VTFGffa1Y7w
   

  

**Department Context**
 The World Bank Group (WBG) is committed to supporting country clients in achieving sustainable development outcomes, including improved health systems, economic growth, education access, climate resilience, and social equity. In this context, digital platforms and data play an increasingly critical role in how development projects are designed, implemented, and adapted.
   

  

 The ITS Operations Products unit (ITSOP) enables digital enablement of the Bank's business processes through a modern, flexible, and user\-friendly digital platform that integrates and optimizes critical functions for thousands of front\-line staff. It also drives the delivery of AI\-powered business solutions to support business priorities and accelerate data\-driven decision\-making across the institution.
   

  

 To strengthen the feedback loop between the realities on the ground and the digital tools that support operations, ITSOP is seeking a Regional Partner embedded within regional operations. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to task teams, regional leadership, and product teams in identifying opportunities to optimize operations through fit\-for\-purpose technology solutions and smarter business processes.
   

  

 As ITSOP advances the reimagining and modernization of the Operations Workspace and related digital platforms, the Regional Partner will play a critical role in supporting three parallel dimensions of change: sustaining day\-to\-day business operations, helping modernization, promoting and contributing to organizational readiness and adoption, and contributing to strategic transformation initiatives. The role will ensure that regional operational realities, stakeholder needs, and field perspectives are incorporated into the design, implementation, and continuous evolution of future digital capabilities and operating models.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This role combines strategic advisory, user and business engagement, and technology enablement, with the goal of helping WBG operations teams implement policies, deliver programs, and scale impact through digital tools and data\-informed practices. This role is part of our commitment to ensuring that digital platforms not only support, but enable operational effectiveness, innovation, and implementation on the ground.
   

  

**The Regional Partner Will Be a**
* Strategic thought partner to regional/country task teams in identifying operational challenges and technology needs.
* Liaison between field realities and the internal product development lifecycle.
* Facilitator of informed decision\-making around digital adoption, technology innovation, and process efficiency.


 This is a solution\-oriented role, requiring strong systems thinking, client orientation, and understanding of both the development context and the possibilities (and limitations) of technology. This role promotes a culture of innovation and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Regional Partner will play a dual\-facing role, working closely with both task teams and regional leadership, and with internal technology and product teams, carrying out the following responsibilities:
   

  

* User and Business Engagement and Operational Insight
* Serve as a trusted advisor to task teams (TTLs), project staff, and regional management on operational technology needs.
* Understand and analyze end\-to\-end business processes across sectors (e.g., health, education) to understand the full context of operations—program goals, delivery challenges, and field constraints, and identify opportunities for efficiency and digital enablement.
* Provide strategic guidance on how existing or new digital solutions can support evolving operational requirements and policy implementation.
* Surface unspoken or emerging needs based on\-the\-ground observation, interviews, and data insights.
* Recommend improvements to business processes through the application of digital tools, automation, or data\-informed workflows.
* Identify patterns or recurring challenges across countries or sectors that can be addressed systemically.
* Advise regional teams on implementation strategies for operational policy changes that require digital adaptation.
* Support regional stakeholders through business and technology transformation initiatives by assessing impacts, gathering requirements, validating future\-state processes, and ensuring operational realities are reflected in transformation planning and execution.
* Technology Advisory and Bridging
* Partner with product managers and solution architects on the design and evolution of digital platforms by providing business context, use cases, and field insights.
* Act as a bridge between regional business teams and central product development teams, translating complex operational problems into clearly scoped technical solutions.
* Evaluate existing technological solutions that may address observed needs, recommend fit\-for\-purpose adaptations where needed.
* Support prioritization by providing business impact framing, user insights, and field validation to product managers.
* Monitor and facilitate technology adoption, performance, and user satisfaction within the region and provide feedback for continuous improvement.
* Change Management and Implementation Support
* Provide thought partnership with regional teams in designing business processes that are both policy\-compliant and technology\-enabled.
* Ensure alignment between institutional operational policies and technical implementation across platforms.
* Work with business and technical teams to promote the adoption of new tools and enhancements, drawing on field insights to shape communication, training, and support strategies.

 in the

 infrastructure\-as\-code tools (like Terraform).

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader.  We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan.  Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

title: Technical Operations Lead
description:
**Company Overview** 




 Founded in 2012,
 **Occams Advisory** 
 is a leading business solutions, professional services and financial advisory provider specializing in growth, financing, and taxation. Serving as a trusted advisor throughout the business lifecycle, Occams combines Fortune 500 expertise, entrepreneurial insights, and a global perspective to deliver world\-class solutions.
 **Occams has achieved remarkable recognition for its rapid growth, securing 8 spots on Inc. magazine’s Fastest Growing 5000 Private Companies list, 4 consecutive rankings on the Financial Times Fastest Growing 500 Companies in the Americas. In 2023, Occams was honored on Fortune’s inaugural list of the 300 Most Innovative Companies.** 




  





 Operating across all U.S. states and territories, Occams boasts a team of over 100 professionals based in major cities worldwide, including New York, Los Angeles, Toronto, Delhi and Mumbai. Its leadership includes alumni from Fortune 500 companies such as Barclays, UBS, and Merrill Lynch, and prestigious academic institutions like NYU, Duke University, and London Business School. Recognized as a leader in professional services, Occams delivers transformative growth and advisory solutions to clients.
 



  





**About Your Role** 




 We are hiring a
 **Lead – Operations** 
 to work directly with the CEO – India as his second in command on the day\-to\-day running of the India teams.
 



 In plain terms, this is the person who stays on top of everything. If Finance says a client agreement is not yet on the portal, you are the one who already has that task in Asana, knows it is stuck because nobody sent the final signed copy, has chased the person who has it, and can tell leadership in one line where it stands. Nothing sits with you and goes quiet, and nobody has to remind you of anything.
 



 You will work across teams: product and technology, finance, client delivery, and our US\-based leadership and partners. Most of your day is getting things moved by people who do not report to you, so you need to be easy to work with and able to build rapport with anyone.
 



 We are looking for someone from an Indian IT services delivery background, where work is finished on the client's deadline and not on the team's convenience. If a deliverable is due on Friday for a US client, it goes out on Friday. You should be comfortable with that way of working and able to build it in the teams around you.
 



 This is also an AI\-native role. Occams is building itself as an AI\-native company: everyone is a builder, work gets recorded so it can be automated, and people write clear specs that AI tools and developers turn into working software. You should already work this way. You use AI tools every day, you can run tasks in Claude Code or a similar tool, and you can write a spec clearly enough that an agent or a developer can build from it. You do not need to be an engineer. You need to be the person who shows the team what AI\-native work looks like.
 



 Our own CRM and ERP platforms are among the main products this role will run, so you need a working knowledge of CRM and ERP software: how it gets built, configured, and rolled out.
 



 You will report to the CEO – India. The role is based in Delhi or Dehradun. Over time, it grows into running operations for the India business.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Running operations** 



* **Own the operational tracker.** 
 Every open item across the India teams sits in Asana with an owner, a blocker if there is one, a next step, and a date. You keep it current every day. Nothing that matters lives in an Excel file or a WhatsApp thread.
* **Follow up and close loops.** 
 You chase, you remember why things are stuck, and you get them unstuck. Forwarding a file to someone else does not count as done.
* **Be the single point of status.** 
 Leadership should be able to ask you about any open item and get a clear answer without checking anywhere else.
* **Run meetings that end in actions.** 
 Set the agenda, capture decisions and owners, and put them in Asana the same day.
* **Keep the process paperwork honest.** 
 Write and maintain SOPs for the work you run, and check that they are actually being followed.



**Running projects** 



* **Own scope and requirements.** 
 Turn what leadership and clients ask for into a written scope with acceptance criteria before work starts.
* **Plan and schedule.** 
 Build the plan backwards from the committed date, with milestones, dependencies, and who does what. Spot slippage early and pull in help before the date is at risk, not after.
* **Manage the team's time.** 
 Know who is on what, see overload coming, and move work around before dates slip.
* **Manage risks and issues.** 
 Keep a live risk list, escalate early, and never let a known risk turn into a surprise.
* **Control change.** 
 When scope changes, say what it does to the date and the effort, in writing, before anyone agrees to it.
* **Run quality and acceptance testing.** 
 Define what done means, run acceptance testing with the business users, and sign off before release.
* **Coordinate releases.** 
 Plan go\-lives with the technology team and the business, with communication and a rollback plan ready.
* **Manage vendors.** 
 Own the relationship with outside developers, IT vendors, and SaaS providers: contracts, service levels, and chasing them the way you chase everyone else.
* **Report to stakeholders.** 
 Weekly written status, a monthly review with leadership, and a clear presentation whenever a decision is needed.
* **Track the numbers that matter.** 
 On\-time delivery, age of open items, defects after release. Use them to improve, not just to report.



**Working AI\-native** 



* **Use AI in your own work every day.** 
 Claude Code, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar, for drafting, analysis, automation, and building small tools.
* **Write specs that AI and developers can build from.** 
 Keep what is wanted separate from how it gets built.
* **Automate the repeated work.** 
 Reporting, status updates, data checks. If a task is done the same way twice, ask whether an agent can do it.
* **Record the work.** 
 Decisions, processes, and outcomes get written down so they can be automated later.
* **Redo workflows when a better way appears.** 
 Be willing to throw out how something is done every few months if AI now does it better.
* **Help the team adopt it.** 
 Show people how, set the example, and call it out when spreadsheets, chat threads, or memory are being used where a system should be.



**Supporting the CEO – India** 



* **Work as his second in command.** 
 Prepare updates, take on tasks delegated to you, and make sure nothing agreed in a leadership conversation gets lost.
* **Present like a consultant.** 
 When a decision is needed, put the problem, the options, and your recommendation in front of leadership or a client, clearly and in a form they can act on.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 




**Education:** 



* Bachelor's degree, engineering or similar preferred. PMP, PRINCE2, or a Master's degree is good to have but not required.



**Experience:** 



* 5 to 8 years in project or delivery management at an Indian IT services or software company, with at least 2 years running client deliveries against fixed deadlines.
* At least one stint at a large, well\-organized company, where process, documentation, and delivery discipline were taken seriously. We want you to have seen how it is done properly, and then be able to do it yourself in a 100\-person firm without a large support team behind you.
* Part of a team that built, customized, or rolled out a CRM or ERP product (for example Salesforce, Zoho, Dynamics, SAP, Odoo, or a home\-grown platform). You know what a CRM or ERP implementation actually involves.
* Worked with US\-based clients, or handled a US team, and are comfortable on US calls and US working hours.



  





**Essential technical skills:** 



* **Asana, Jira, or similar as the single source of truth.** 
 You prefer a system over spreadsheets, and you keep it clean.
* **AI tools in daily use.** 
 You can run tasks in Claude Code or a similar tool, and you know what to hand to AI and what to keep for yourself.
* **Presentation skills at the level of an EY or McKinsey consultant.**

 comfortable on calls with US stakeholders.
* **A track record of closing things out.** 
 In interviews we will ask for specific examples.
* **Basic understanding of software delivery.**

**Preferred Skills:**

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Role:** 
 Engineering Manager
 



**Function:** 
 Engineering / Technology
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media
 



  





**About Company** 




 One of India's largest private FM radio networks, reaching 40 million\+ listeners weekly. The company operates across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 With a team of 740, the company moves fast and values local relevance across metro and non\-metro India.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 This role leads end\-to\-end engineering delivery for the company's digital products, owning backend and frontend engineering across a team of 7–8 engineers. The manager will be accountable for architectural decisions, engineering velocity, and the reliability of distributed systems that serve millions of listeners on the company's digital streaming platform and related products. This is a hands\-on leadership role requiring both technical depth and the ability to grow and align a cross\-functional engineering team.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Lead, mentor, and grow a cross\-functional team of 7–8 backend and frontend engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development
* Own architectural decisions for distributed backend systems and shared platform services supporting multiple digital products
* Drive engineering best practices — code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, observability, incident response, and service reliability
* Partner with product, design, and content teams to translate business requirements into engineering plans with clear timelines and milestones
* Define and track engineering KPIs (uptime, latency, deployment frequency, error rates) and hold the team accountable to them
* Identify and resolve technical debt, scalability bottlenecks, and infrastructure gaps proactively
* Collaborate with senior leadership on platform strategy, resource planning, and build\-vs\-buy decisions



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–8 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in an engineering management role leading backend and/or frontend teams
* Prior experience at high\-scale B2C consumer product companies with large concurrent user bases
* Hands\-on experience designing and scaling distributed backend systems with RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs at consumer scale
* Proficiency in at least one modern backend language — Go, Java, Node.js, or Python — used in production at scale
* Production experience with at least one major cloud provider: GCP, AWS, or Azure
* Hands\-on experience deploying backend services using Kubernetes, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines
* Strong command of data modeling, caching strategies, service decomposition, and microservices architecture in a consumer\-facing product environment
* Demonstrated experience managing cross\-functional engineering teams of 5\+ engineers, including hiring and performance management



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience architecting shared backend platforms supporting multiple products or business verticals
* Prior experience in media, streaming, audio/video platforms, or content\-heavy consumer applications
* Familiarity with CDN architecture, adaptive streaming protocols, or real\-time content delivery at scale
* Exposure to ad\-tech, programmatic advertising, or listener analytics platforms



  





**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to lead engineering for one of India's most recognized media brands, with direct impact on 40M\+ weekly listeners
* Ownership of a growing digital streaming platform at an inflection point in its product and engineering maturity
* Onsite role in Delhi with a creative, fast\-moving team deeply embedded in Indian culture and communities

title: Product Development Lead, Grids of the Future
company: The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet
description:
The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 About the Global Energy Alliance
   

  

 The Global Energy Alliance (the Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
   

  

 Grids of the Future is GEA's programme for delivering abundant, reliable, and clean electricity across the Global South. In many emerging economies, the utilities that supply most electricity are held back by aging infrastructure, underinvestment, and a lack of reliable data. Efforts to modernize often remain stuck in isolated pilots rather than reaching the whole grid. The programme works in close partnership with utilities, governments, regulators, and innovators. It supports grid digitalization, the integration of renewables and battery storage, greater demand flexibility, and a stronger network of local innovators. Together, these help emerging economies move from aging, fossil fuel dependent grids to modern grids that are ready for renewable energy. The programme brings together the policy, regulatory, and delivery work that this transition depends on.
   

  

**Why this role matters**
 The Product Development Lead will lead the full end to end Product lifecycle for the Open Source solutions/products being developed by Global Energy Alliance with its Alliance partners to ensure that the valuable work being carried out by GEA and other partners in the clean energy ecosystem is supported with the right technology tools.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The position leads the end to end development including clearly defining requirements, holding the schematics, managing the vendors and delivering to internal and external stakeholders. This is a critical role to manage the delivery of the technological infrastructure supporting GEA's global Grids of the Future programme.
   

  

 It supports the Grids of the Future teams across GEA's priority markets, including India, Southeast Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Africa. The work helps low\-and\-middle\-income countries modernize their grids and integrate large volumes of low\-cost renewable energy in a reliable and financially sustainable way. The role draws on product management experience in the technology field along with strong project management skills.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
**Lead End\-to\-End Product Lifecycle \& Technology Delivery**
* Lead the end\-to\-end product lifecycle of Grids of the Future (GOTF) digital and technological infrastructure products, translating programme goals into actionable product roadmaps, clear requirements, schematics, and functional specifications, feature releases.
* Oversee the development, testing, and deployment of technology tools, incorporating AI\-powered development, tools, and rollouts to ensure digital solutions meet rigorous standards for Utility and partner deployment. Must be fluent with Open Source Software development.
* Design product requirement documents in conjunction with the GOTF architecture team


**Vendor Management, Architecture \& Technical Governance**
* Manage technology vendors and external development partners throughout the project lifecycle, enforcing strict quality control, version control, risk management, and service\-level agreements.
* Oversee technical schematics, architectural frameworks, and project documentation to ensure software and digital tools are scalable, secure, interoperable, and aligned with utility operating environments.
* Maintain comprehensive project management governance, proactively managing project timelines, budgets, multi\-stakeholder dependencies, and technical deliverables.


**Regional Execution, Stakeholder Alignment \& Utility Integration**
* Partner closely with regional and country\-level GOTF teams across GEAPP priority markets (India, Southeast Asia, Latin America \& the Caribbean, and Africa) to tailor product offerings to local grid contexts, regulatory frameworks, and market conditions.
* Hire Design Partners for deployment of the products and nurture relationships with the necessary stakeholders at the Design Partner sites.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners—including distribution utilities, system operators, regulators, and clean energy ecosystem innovators—to ensure digital products address operational pain points and enable demand flexibility.
* Provide technical guidance, training, and change management support to internal teams and utility counterparts to accelerate the adoption and institutionalisation of new digital grid solutions.


**Knowledge Sharing \& Continuous Product Innovation**
* Track emerging technological advancements, AI tools, and digital grid innovations across advanced and emerging power markets, channelling actionable insights to refine GEAPP's product portfolio.
* Establish product performance metrics and impact indicators to evaluate tool adoption, operational efficacy, and contribution to clean energy access and emissions reduction goals.


**Product release and evangelization**
* Lead Product release planning and execution with the communications team. Work as the single point of contact for the feature release calendar.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Experience**
 The ideal candidate would be a self\-starter and be willing to “roll up their sleeves” to adapt to working in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.
   

  

**Essential Qualifications, Skills And Experience Include**
* At least 8 years of work experience as a Product Manager, developing for Power Sector.
* A minimum bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as technology, product design, business management; an engineering or renewable energy qualification will be a strong plus.
* FOSS development experience is a priority. Candidates with already committed projects will be preferred. Understanding of AI (LLMs, inference and coding tools) is a must have.
* Strong network and relationships with power sector stakeholders across one or more of GEA's priority markets; experience spanning both Global North and Global South power systems will be a strong advantage.
* Direct experience of working with AI powered development and roll out.
* Demonstrated commitment to working to improve the lives of others and to working in the impact sector.
* Willingness to travel internationally across GEA's priority markets for project execution, if required.


**Behavioural Competencies**
 The ideal candidate should be able to demonstrate the following:
   

  

* Sector knowledge: understanding of FOSS, AI tooling and delivering technology solutions to rigorous client standards. Experience with grid modernization, renewable energy integration, distribution and transmission systems, grid flexibility, and storage in the context of global south electricity sectors, including India is a plus.
* Experience of working with utilities: good understanding of utility operations, planning, and working mechanisms, including the institutional and political complexities of state\-owned distribution companies.
* Vendor management: a track record of delivering technology projects through vendors. High levels of attention to detail, version control, risk management and clear mapping of roles and responsibilities.
* Communication \& Presentation: excellent interpersonal abilities and listening skills; strong writing and presentation skills; able to present ideas to a range of stakeholders in a clear and compelling way.
* Project Execution: strong project management skills; meets deadlines; sense of urgency and responsibility; ability to multi\-task and work under pressure; detail oriented.


*We operate from a strong commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion in everything we do. It is not only the right thing to do – we could not make an impact without our team members' diverse perspectives and experiences. We expect all Global Energy Alliance employees to contribute by developing their unique perspectives and talent, challenging conventional wisdom through evidence and reason, and amplifying marginalized voices.* 
  

  

*Global Energy Alliance is committed to the principles of equal employment opportunity and compliance with all federal, state, and local laws concerning employment discrimination, including the Americans with Disabilities Act. To this end, the organization ensures equal opportunity to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, age, gender, sexual orientation, religion, marital status, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, lawful alien status, physical, mental, and medical disability, veteran status, or liability for service in the United States Armed Forces.*

title: Senior Program coordinator/ Program Officer - Technical and Operation
description:
**Overview**
 Jhpiego is an international, non\-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high\-quality, low\-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
   

  

 Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on\-the\-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real\-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non\-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).
   

  

**About The Program**
 Jhpiego provides strategic technical assistance to the Government of India's National TB Elimination Program (NTEP) to accelerate TB elimination through health systems strengthening, implementation research, digital innovations, and evidence\-based interventions. Working closely with the Central TB Division (CTD), State TB Cells, the National Health Mission (NHM), and development partners, Jhpiego supports the delivery of high\-quality, people\-centered TB services across the continuum of care.
   

  

 The program implements several national and multi\-state initiatives, including the Pro TB Impact Project, which strengthens TB service delivery at the primary healthcare level by integrating routine TB screening into Ayushman Arogya Mandirs (AAMs) and maternal health services, promoting differentiated care for high\-risk TB patients, and establishing learning labs to generate evidence for scalable interventions. Jhpiego also leads the Cough Syrup Sales Surveillance Initiative, an innovative pharmacy and AYUSH\-linked surveillance model that leverages digital technologies, community engagement, and referral systems to enable early identification of individuals with presumptive TB and ensure timely linkage to diagnostic and treatment services under NTEP.
   

  

**About The Position**
 Jhpiego is seeking a dynamic and motivated professional to support the implementation and coordination of national and state\-level TB initiatives.
   

  

 The incumbent will provide technical, operational, and program management support across multiple TB projects, ensuring effective implementation in accordance with approved work plans, timelines, donor requirements, and Jhpiego policies. The position requires independent management of assigned workstreams, coordination with government and implementation partners, preparation of high\-quality technical documentation, monitoring of project deliverables, and support for day\-to\-day project operations.
   

  

 The successful candidate should possess strong organizational, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Program Coordination and Implementation Support
* Independently coordinate selected project activities in line with work plans and timelines.
* Track deliverables, identify risks, and proactively escalate delays with recommended mitigation.
* Provide technical and operational support to field teams to ensure activity quality and adherence to standards.
* Contribute to development of technical briefs, implementation notes, and program presentations.
* Stakeholder and Relationship Management
* Liaise with district/state stakeholders, internal teams, and external partners for smooth program execution.
* Build effective working relationships to enable timely communication, joint reviews, and activity follow ‑
* Represent the project in selected technical discussions, review meetings, and coordination forums.
* Meetings, Reviews and Documentation
* Lead coordination of program meetings, technical reviews, and trainings at national/state/district levels.
* Prepare high ‑ quality minutes, tracking sheets, action plans, and follow ‑ up matrices.
* Support development of donor reports (monthly/quarterly/annual), ensuring accuracy and completeness.
* Operations, Logistics and Finance Coordination
* Independently handle logistics, and procurement coordination as per organizational
* Track budgets, GRFs, activity expenses, purchase requests, and settlements.
* Maintain updated records of procurements, inventory, and key documentation.
* Monitoring, Data and Knowledge Management
* Maintain trackers, dashboards, and databases for monitoring deliverables and program outputs.
* Support data collation and validation from field teams.
* Document learnings, best practices, and case studies to contribute to knowledge management.
* Other Responsibilities
* Provide cross\-team coordination support for training, workshops, and reviews.
* Undertake additional tasks aligned with project goals as assigned by the supervisor.


**Required Qualifications**
* Master’s in business administration/ post graduate diploma/ master’s in social work/ MA/ MCom/ PG Diploma/ MSc or a related discipline from a recognized institution.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of relevant experience in program coordination, project management, or implementation support, preferably in public health or development programs.
* Experience working with donor\-funded projects and government stakeholders is desirable.
* Prior experience with the NTEP or TB\-related programs will be an added advantage.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong program coordination and ability to independently manage assigned workstreams.
* Result\-oriented mindset with strong follow\-up and closure skills.
* Excellent relationship management and interpersonal communication.
* Strong documentation, reporting, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel (trackers), PowerPoint, and Microsoft Office tools.
* Ability to work collaboratively with multi\-disciplinary teams and external stakeholders.


 Jhpiego is an equal opportunity employer and offers a highly dynamic and enabling work environment. Jhpiego offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive employee benefits package. Women candidates are encouraged to apply.

* Contribute to a customer\-centric and outcome\-driven product culture by bringing user insights, data, and structured problem\-solving into product decisions.

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Business/MBA, or a related discipline.

* Proven Product Management/Product Ownership experience, including product strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, requirements, and end\-to\-end delivery.

* Ability to work effectively across business and technology teams, manage multiple priorities, and operate in a complex enterprise environment.
* Curiosity and willingness to develop expertise across product management, cloud, data, analytics, AI, and GenAI.
* Experience or exposure to enterprise data platforms, data warehouses, data marketplaces, self\-service analytics, data governance, cloud\-based data products, or AI/GenAI\-enabled experiences is highly desirable.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Backdrop**
 AVIZVA is a Healthcare Technology Organization that harnesses technology to simplify, accelerate, \& optimize the way healthcare enterprises deliver care. Established in 2011, we have served as strategic enablers for healthcare enterprises, helping them enhance their overall care delivery.
   

  

 With over 15 years of expertise, we have engineered more than 150 tailored products for leading Medical Health Plans, Dental and Vision Plan Providers, PBMs, Medicare Plan Providers, TPAs, and more.
   

  

**Overview Of The Role**
 As a Scrum Master at AVIZVA, you will be the proud skipper of project\-level Scrum Ceremonies. You will act as a bridge of dialogue between the Scrum Team and other important stakeholders. You will not just spot and voice the potential hiccups in your team’s progress, but you will build solid safeguards by joining forces both within and beyond the team
   

  

 As an ambassador of Scrum principles and values, you will coach your team to be a devoted Scrum follower. You will master the project scope curriculum and learn the program goal basics. You will team\-up with the Product Owner and make sure that the product backlog is always up to the minute. You will be the face of your Scrum team in cross\-team dependency reviews.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Acquire a holistic overview of all ongoing projects and initiatives within the allocated program to develop a thorough understanding of the assigned project, its objectives, scope, and alignment with the overall business strategy.
* Consolidate broader program\-level knowledge with deeper project\-level insights to identify significant cross\-team dependencies.
* Act as the primary custodian of Scrum practices and processes for the team.
* Lead the Scrum process by driving a series of Scrum ceremonies, such as Sprint Planning, Daily Standup, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective, ensuring their effectiveness and alignment with the team's goals.
* Mentor the team by helping them understand Agile practices, Scrum principles, product vision, and scope, empowering them to develop a shared sense of ownership and a continuous drive toward improvement.
* Monitor the project's progress and provide timely feedback to ensure on\-time deliverables, driving clear and transparent communication within the team and with all external stakeholders.
* Identify technical and people\-centered roadblocks and risks that might hinder the team's progress towards deliverables, collaborating with team members and stakeholders to define targeted risk mitigation strategies and proactively eliminate risks.
* Estimate story points and assist the Product Owner in refining and maintaining the product backlog using project management tools, ensuring visibility and transparency for all stakeholders.
* Represent the team in the weekly Scrum of Scrums meeting, presenting a detailed report on the team's progress, achievements in the previous sprint, and alignment with the defined project goals.
* Attend the Program Increment (PI) Planning event and drive clear communication on workflow alignment and dependencies with multiple stakeholders of the Agile Release Train.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
* 2 to 5 years of hands\-on experience as a Scrum Master or in an Agile project management role.
* Experience in facilitating Scrum events (Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective).
* Extensive hands\-on expertise in utilizing Agile project management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent) for comprehensive planning, tracking, and execution of Agile projects.
* Knowledge of Agile automation, Kanban practices, and Lean principles.
* Familiarity with Agile estimation techniques (e.g., Story Pointing, Planning Poker).
* Analytical and proactive approach to problem\-solving, risk mitigation, and task prioritization, with excellent communication and transparency skills.
* Ability to take ownership of tasks and drive quick, well\-informed decision\-making through a solutions\-oriented mindset.


**Good To Have**
* Expertise in project scheduling tools such as Advanced Roadmap and PI Planning tools.
* Working knowledge of SAFe.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (preferred).
* Positive and enthusiastic approach to learning and adapting to new methodologies.

description:

**If we receive a high volume of applications, we may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.**
**About The Job**
 The Product Engineer designs and builds the digital products that farmers, field teams, programme partners, and BCI teams rely on to collect data and carry out field activities. The role combines product judgement, design sensibility, and hands\-on software engineering to turn field and programme requirements into simple, reliable products in production. The Product Engineer is key strengthening the quality and usability of Better Cotton's field\-facing digital tools and, in turn, the efficiency of field operations across our programme geographies.
   

  

****The Challenge****
 Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will be responsible for :
   

  

* Review and stress\-test requirements from subject\-matter experts and programme teams, identifying unclear assumptions and unnecessary complexity before build begins.
* Partner with the Product Designer to shape simple, effective user flows for mobile, offline, and multilingual field use.
* Translate agreed solutions into clear, prioritised, testable delivery increments, and build high\-quality features across frontend, backend, and data layers.
* Use AI coding agents throughout prototyping, development, testing, and debugging to accelerate delivery without compromising quality, security, or maintainability.
* Write automated tests and instrument products to track adoption, performance, and reliability in real\-world field conditions.
* Release features safely, support their rollout, and iterate based on field feedback and product usage data.
* Work collaboratively with the line manager to set clear, outcome\-based objectives that align with function\-wide and organisational goals.
* Take ownership of agreed objectives, ensuring alignment with team priorities and performance expectations.


**Experience**
 the following skills, knowledge, and experience:
   

  

**Essential**
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience, with a strong track record of personally building, shipping, and improving production digital products that users value and rely on; evidence of judgement, scope, and delivery matters more than tenure.
* Experience taking products from prototype through production, rollout, and continuous improvement.
* Strong product and interaction\-design judgement, gained working closely with designers and subject\-matter experts.
* Experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of development, testing, debugging, and code review.
* Experience testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production applications.
* Experience with agriculture, field operations, offline products, multilingual interfaces, geospatial workflows, or products for users with varying digital literacy is valuable.
* Experience building modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and related frontend technologies.
* Experience developing backend services, APIs, and databases using Python (or a comparable language), SQL, and cloud\-based infrastructure.
* Fluency in written and spoken English is essential.


**Desirable**
* Proficiency in Hindi, Urdu, Swahili, or other relevant languages would be advantageous.


**What We Offer**
* Hybrid working opportunity, with the office days based in Delhi.
* The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year
* Flexible working, with core hours from 10 am to 4 pm local time
* Continuous learning and development
* Pension scheme
* A generous annual leave package, including paid holiday, public holidays, additional paid days off during the festive season, study and exam days, and extra discretionary leave for life events such as family weddings or moving home
* Enhanced parental benefits
* The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.


****Working arrangements****
 The position is full\-time (40 hours per week) and will be based in Delhi. Better Cotton Initiative offers flexible working, with core hours being 10 am – 4 pm. The position may require limited international travel.
   

  

****Apply now****
 Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1\-page maximum) by or before
 ****08\.10\.2026****
 via the application link.
   

  

 In your cover letter, please include an explanation of why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton Initiative. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.
   

  

 Better Cotton Initiative does not use artificial intelligence or in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human\-led assessment experience.
   

  

****Our hiring process****
**Initial Screening**
 Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicant. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.
   

  

**Interviews**
 If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton Initiative may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management. As an internal candidate, you may have discussions regarding your current responsibilities and how they will transition to the new position.
   

  

**Assessment And Testing**
 Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position. Internal candidates may have the option to demonstrate their existing skills through current job performance or past project outcomes.
   

  

**Reference Checks**
 Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications, and for some roles, your education and criminal history. Internal candidates may be asked for references from current or previous supervisors within Better Cotton Initiative to provide insights into their performance and capabilities.
   

  

**Offer Stage**
 After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If you are selected and your references are relevant and satisfactory, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details. For internal candidates, the offer process may include a discussion about how your transition to the new role will be managed and any support needed for a smooth handover.
   

  

**About Better Cotton Initiative**
 Better Cotton Initiative is a global not\-for\-profit organisation supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand. In just 15 years we have aligned more than a fifth of the world’s cotton with our standard and helped farmers and farming communities thrive. Join us in building a better, more sustainable future for cotton worldwide.
   

  

**About Our Values**
 The post holder will be expected to operate in line with our workplace values which are:
   

  

* Trustworthy (including honest, transparent, credible)
* As having Integrity (including responsible, authentic)
* Positive (including problem\-solving, pragmatic)
* Engaging (including adaptable, inclusive, holistic)
* Daring (including courageous, innovative, game\-changing)


****Being you @ Better Cotton****
****Initiative****
 Better Cotton Initiative is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources.
   

  

 We have a zero\-tolerance approach to any attitudes or behaviours that put children or adults at risk of harm. Safeguarding incidents are acts of serious misconduct and are grounds for disciplinary action, up to and including, dismissal and referral to relevant authorities for criminal prosecution. Therefore, all offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks.

title: Associate Manager Product Design (Design)
description:
**Associate Manager Product Design**
 Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
   

  

 As we establish our India Engineering Center of Excellence (COE), we are looking for an experienced Associate Product Design Engineer. As an Associate Product Design Manager at Bitwarden, you will step into a leadership role that blends people management with hands\-on product design. You believe security products can be both protective and genuinely delightful to use — and you want to help a team of designers bring that vision to life. You’ll support, coach, and grow a small team of product designers while continuing to contribute to the craft yourself. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineering leads, and cross\-functional partners to shape the overall design direction across the Bitwarden platform.
   

  

 This is a rare opportunity for an experienced IC designer ready to take their first step into formal people management — without fully stepping away from the work they love.
   

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Manage, mentor, and grow a small team of product designers — running 1:1s, supporting career development, and fostering a culture of craft and collaboration
* Partner with product managers and engineering leads to set design priorities, align roadmaps, and advocate for the user experience across the Bitwarden platform
* Contribute directly to select initiatives — creating user flows, wireframes, high\-fidelity mockups, and prototypes as needed
* Facilitate design critiques and review sessions, helping the team produce consistent, high\-quality, and accessible work
* Facilitate user research and testing practices — helping the team plan and execute feedback cycles that inform design decisions with evidence
* Drive cross\-functional alignment by clearly communicating design rationale to a diverse stakeholder audience, including leadership
* Identify and implement process improvements that increase design team effectiveness, quality, and velocity
* Uphold and evolve Bitwarden’s design system and standards across desktop, mobile (iOS \& Android), web, and browser extension


**WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN**
* 3–5 years of experience in product design, with at least some informal experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating the work of other designers
* A portfolio that demonstrates strong UI craft, systems thinking, and the ability to solve complex UX problems across platforms
* Proficiency in Figma and familiarity with other design and developer tools (e.g., Claude, Loveable, Replit, ChatGPT, V0, Adobe, GitHub)
* Experience planning and facilitating user research, testing sessions, and design critiques
* Ability to communicate design decisions with clarity — through sketches, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and in conversation with stakeholders
* A collaborative and adaptable mindset, comfortable navigating ambiguity and prioritizing across competing demands
* Strong verbal and written communication skills paired with openness and authenticity — you give and receive feedback well
* The desire to grow as a manager: you’re energized by helping others do their best work, not just doing it yourself
* Excitement and enthusiasm for open source software and better internet security


**NICE\-TO\-HAVE**
* Experience in a player\-coach or tech lead role on a design team
* Startup or fast\-growth company experience
* Familiarity with WCAG accessibility guidelines
* Experience designing for security\-focused applications
* Experience designing for both B2C and B2B customers
* Cross\-platform design experience (desktop, mobile, web, browser extension)
* Front\-end development experience or strong familiarity with engineering practices


**DESIGN AT BITWARDEN**
 The Product Design team at Bitwarden is dedicated to simplifying the management of sensitive data for users of all skill levels, with a focus on creating user\-friendly experiences that enhance efficiency and security. We aim to provide clear options and guide users toward best practices. Bitwarden’s design team strives to create experiences where everyone can manage their data with confidence, fostering trust through a consistent and transparent approach. With this intention, we aim to enhance user experiences by transforming routine tasks into enjoyable moments, ultimately making every interaction with our products delightful and empowering for our customers.
   

  

**WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS**
* Meeting with our Talent Acquisition Team
* Interview with Hiring Manager
* Interview with team members
* Portfolio review
* References


**A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US**
* The Bitwarden user community loves staying secure, and the feeling is mutual. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose and bring a more secure internet experience to everyone, from friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
* Become an expert. You’ll become immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open\-source software.
* Bitwarden remains dedicated to building a diverse and talented team.
* Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with your team’s support and join the Bitwarden \#growth\-club to continue your personal and professional development.

title: Scrum Master, AVP
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master
   

  

* We’re looking for an experienced Scrum Master to drive a culture of continuous improvement
* You’ll make sure that your team lives by the values of Scrum, empowering them to become high performing to increase the productivity, as well as frequency and quality of delivery
* Hone your project skills as you work with talented people in collaborative and innovative environment, with access to the bank's Agile community, experts and events
* We're offering this role at associate vice president level


 What you'll do
   

  

 This role will see you coaching and guiding your team to perform at their highest level and at a sustainable pace. You’ll remove any impediments to progress, facilitate meetings, protect the team from outside influences or distractions and work with the product owner to make sure that the product backlog is in good shape and ready for the next sprint.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Making sure the Scrum team understands Agile practices, the Scrum framework and values, and that the team uses this framework to deliver working software to satisfy platform customers and react to their needs quickly
* Transforming the Scrum team to become self\-organising to reduce management overhead costs, using techniques such as Systems and Lean thinking
* Acting as the process owner for the team, and maintaining relationships with the project's key stakeholders
* Creating a great place to work with a culture of safety and continuous improvement, through great people leadership, coaching, engagement and development of skills


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 We're looking for someone with experience of successful Scrum adoption along with a Scrum Master certification. You'll need knowledge of modern development practices and tools, as well as a background in coaching cross\-functional teams into high performing teams.
   

  

 You’ll also need knowledge of servant leadership, facilitation, situational awareness, conflict resolution, continual improvement, empowerment, and increasing transparency, as well as experience of building a culture of transparency within feature teams by empowering individuals and inspiring a collaborative team performance.
   

  

**We'll Look To You To Demonstrate**
* Experience working as a Scrum Master in Agile environments.
* Strong knowledge of Scrum, Agile frameworks, and SAFe practices.
* Excellent facilitation, coaching, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Experience managing dependencies across multiple teams and complex technology initiatives
* Experience of automated testing frameworks

title: Senior Analyst
description:

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Analyst
   

  

**Overview**
 Job Description Summary
   

  

 Mastercard Services, the professional services arm of Mastercard Worldwide, provides payments\-focused consulting, marketing, platforms, information, loyalty and risk management services to financial institutions, retailers and governments worldwide. The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting\-edge services that help our customers grow. Focused on thinking big and scaling fast around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end\-to\-end solutions for a diverse global customer base. Centered on data\-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments\-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business Test \& Learn experimentation, and data\-driven information and risk management services.
   

  

 As part of the Services Data \& Productivity Engineering team, the successful candidate will drive world\-class operations at the core of all product development, delivery, and support. They will support a comprehensive process improvement strategy with a focus towards achieving scale for future growth by improving quality and efficiency across the Services division through the identification and development of business process automation solutions.
   

  

 ROLE
   

  

* Manage complex resolutions, and design and develop automation solutions to complex problems
* Contribute to ongoing incubation of new low code applications
* Manage the overall coordination, status reporting, schedules and stability of project\-oriented work efforts, ensures that project goals and objectives are met within agreed upon time, scope and resource requirements
* Develop detailed project plans and manages all implementation processes
* Regularly communicate to senior management regarding the status of specific project deliverables, and interact with stakeholders to set and manage expectations

* Optimize business processes to achieve more efficient results including establishing standard processes and best practices
* Translate customer needs into process improvement objectives, and establishes/coordinates a plan for implementation
* Communicate process issues or updates to stakeholders, and assesses and recommends opportunities for improvement
* Mentor and guide junior team members, fostering technical growth and ensuring adherence to quality standards and delivery best practices


**All About You**
* Strong knowledge of analytics applications (i.e. Alteryx, Tableau, Qlik)

* Applies knowledge of current business processes and products to maintain and enhance solutions currently in place
* Experience creating and delivering presentations for internal learning, training events and/or business discussions
* Experience working in cross\-functional and large projects
* Well versed with challenges in working remotely with global teams
* Proven ability to evaluate technical and business feasibility swiftly, enabling agile decision\-making and minimizing delivery bottlenecks


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About the position** 




 Based in Gurugram, you will lead our newly established software team (currently four engineers) as we enter an exciting new phase of expansion. We are seeking an Engineering Manager who will build a strong, happy, high\-performing team, creating the environment, clarity, and support that enables people to do their best work. This is a people\-first role: you will have proven strength in leadership, scaling teams, and developing others. You will report to the Head of Software Product Engineering.
 



  





 Aurora’s mission is to help drive the energy transition through data\-driven energy market intelligence and software that supports decision\-makers across the power system. You will partner closely with colleagues in Oxford and across the business to help the team build customer\-facing software that delivers on this mission.
 



  





 Our platform includes microservices and modern web applications (TypeScript/Node, React, AWS). While this is a leadership\-focused role, you will still do some hands\-on senior engineering work, contributing code when needed, leading by example on quality, and helping the team make sound technical decisions.
 



  





 You will establish the people and process foundations for an effective engineering team: regular 1:1s, coaching and feedback, inclusive ways of working, and strong delivery practices (planning, stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives). A key part of the role is growing the team through hiring, attracting, assessing, and onboarding great talent in Gurugram.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




  




* Lead and grow the Gurugram engineering team, creating a positive, inclusive, high\-trust culture with strong team health and engagement.
* Hire, onboard, and retain great engineers, owning the hiring process end\-to\-end in partnership with HR and engineering leadership.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members through 1:1s, goal setting, feedback, and growth plans; support performance management when needed.
* Contribute as a senior engineer: write and review code, guide architecture and technical design, and continuously raise the bar on engineering standards (testing, reliability, and maintainability).
* Run effective engineering processes and ceremonies (planning, daily coordination, reviews, and especially high\-quality retrospectives) that drive continuous improvement and predictable delivery.
* Partner with Product and stakeholders to shape priorities, manage expectations, and ensure the team delivers valuable outcomes with a sustainable pace and high quality.



  





**What we are looking for** 




  






 Required attributes:
 



* Strong people leadership and emotional intelligence: able to build trust, communicate clearly, handle difficult conversations, and foster psychological safety.
* Proven experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineers (including regular 1:1s, feedback, goal setting, and progression support), with a genuine interest in people development.
* Demonstrated hiring capability: defining roles, running structured interviews, assessing both technical and behavioural skills, and making high\-quality hiring decisions.
* Experience running effective team processes (e.g., planning, reviews, and retrospectives) and using outcomes to drive continuous improvement.
