 Desirable attributes:
 



* Experience using delivery metrics (e.g., DORA) to inform team practices.
* Experience with engineering quality practices such as unit testing and CI/CD pipelines.



  





**What we Offer** 



* A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
* A competitive salary package
* Access to regular coaching and mentoring sessions and the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals
* Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects

title: Assistant Director
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job title:** 
 Account Excellence Tech Adoption Lead
   

  

**Function:** 
 Clients \& Industries
   

  

**Sub‑Function:** 
 Global Account Excellence
   

  

**Overview**
 The Account Excellence Tech Adoption Lead is an integral member of the Global Client Excellence team, responsible for leading and accelerating the adoption of Account Excellence technology across EY’s global account landscape.
   

  

 With strong and growing demand from Regions to automate account processes, improve data transparency, and scale adoption of account technology, this role provides a single‑point ownership for the delivery and adoption of Account Excellence tools (e.g. Account LENS and adjacent platforms). It also plays a pivotal role in translating high level account tech requirements and feeding these to the Digital Engagement team to ensure the account technology roadmap aligns with end user needs.
   

  

 Operating in a complex, matrixed, global environment, the role combines account management expertise, technology translation, and delivery leadership to ensure that account technology is:
   

  

* Strategically aligned to Account Excellence priorities
* Designed around real account team workflows
* Delivered at pace, with disciplined pilots and rollouts
* Embedded into BAU with clear ownership and measurable impact


 The role partners closely with the Global C\&I Domains in particular Digital Engagement and Global Industry and works closely with Regions, Service Lines and priority accounts to drive consistency, momentum and data‑informed decision making across the end‑to‑end of the account lifecycle.
   

  

**Purpose of the Role**
 The Account Excellence Tech Adoption Lead is responsible for driving account excellence through the delivery, adoption and BAU handover of account technology
   

  

 The role plays a critical part in partnering with the Digital Engagement team to:
   

  

* Translate Account Excellence strategy into practical, scalable technology solutions
* Accelerate process automation and insight generation for account teams
* Enable consistent, transparent leadership decision making through trusted data
* Drive on‑time delivery across multi‑stakeholder initiatives
* Ensure smooth transition from pilot and deployment into sustained BAU ownership


**Key Responsibilities**
 The role’s primary responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  

**Account Excellence Technology Strategy \& Roadmap**
* Be the single point of contact in Client Excellence to collate account technology needs aligned to global Account Excellence priorities.
* Partner with Digital Engagement to shape priorities across current tooling, enhancements and future capabilities.
* Ensure clear articulation of the role each tool plays in enabling account teams and where each fits within end‑to‑end workflows.


**Delivery, Pilots \& Rollout**
* In partnership with Digital Engagement and Regions,
+ Lead the planning and execution of pilots with Regions and priority accounts to test, refine and validate new or enhanced account technology.
+ Coordinate multi‑stakeholder delivery across Global, Regional, Industry and Service Line teams.
+ Drive disciplined delivery management, including milestones, risks, dependencies and decision points.
+ Ensure technology initiatives are delivered on time, with clear outcomes and readiness for scale.


**Adoption, Embedding \& BAU Transition**
* Partner with Account Excellence Leads, Change \& Adoption, and Regions to ensure strong adoption and sustained use of account technology.
* Provide input to and support Digital Engagement in setting clear BAU ownership models, handover plans and support structures.
* Embed technology into standard Account Excellence rhythms, governance and ways of working (not “optional extras”).
* Monitor adoption and usage signals, feeding insights back into roadmap iteration.


**Data, Insights \& Leadership Enablement**
* Enable consistent, trusted account data to support leadership insight, investment decisions and portfolio management.
* Ensure transparency of account activity, commitments and outcomes through fit‑for‑purpose dashboards and reporting.
* Translate data into clear narratives and insights that leaders can act on.


**Stakeholder Orchestration \& Governance**
* Act as the central point of coordination across a complex stakeholder landscape (Regions, Industries, Service Lines, Digital, GDS).
* Drive alignment on priorities, sequencing and trade‑offs.
* Support governance forums with clear status, decisions required and progress tracking.
* Build strong, trusted relationships that enable pace without fragmentation.


**Key Relationships**
* Global Client Excellence Leader; Account Excellence Leader and Global Account Excellence team
* Digital Engagement
* Regional Account Activation Leaders and teams
* Global Industries and Service Lines
* Priority account leadership teams and pilots
* Change \& Adoption Leads


**Knowledge, Skills And Experience**
 The successful candidate will demonstrate:
   

  

**Technology \& Product Leadership**
* End‑to‑end ownership of Account Excellence technology adoption, from delivery, adoption to BAU handover.
* Strong understanding of account platforms, CRM, dashboards, workflow automation and data‑driven reporting.
* Partner with Digital Engagement on AI development to accelerate process automation and insight generation, improving efficiency, transparency and decision quality.


**Delivery, Change \& Execution**
* Proven experience delivering complex, multi‑stakeholder technology initiatives in a global, matrixed environment.
* Strong program and project management capability, including planning, dependency management, risk mitigation and delivery tracking.
* Disciplined, outcome‑oriented delivery approach with a bias to action and momentum.
* Experience leading pilot‑to‑scale transitions, ensuring solutions are adoption‑ready and sustainably embedded into BAU.


**Business, Account \& Data Acumen**
* Strong grounding in account management, client excellence or commercial operations, enabling credible technology design for real account needs.
* Ability to translate business and account requirements into clear technology and data requirements, working effectively with the Digital Engagement teams.
* Understanding of account governance, investment management and portfolio oversight, and how technology supports leadership decision making.
* Focus on enabling trusted data, consistent metrics and transparent insights for leaders.


**Stakeholder \& Leadership Capability**
* Credibility with senior stakeholders and account leaders, operating confidently in governance and leadership forums.
* Strong influencing skills to align Regions, Service Lines, Industry/Sector and accounts on Client Excellence priorities and trade‑offs.
* Responsible for working with Client Excellence leadership to prioritize technology needs as key input into the C\&I Tech roadmap
* Leads through influence rather than authority, balancing strategic intent with hands‑on execution.


**Professional \& Leadership Attributes**
* Strong business acumen, executive presence and clear, concise communication skills.
* High levels of ownership, resilience and personal accountability.
* Operates autonomously, proactively identifying risks, issues and opportunities rather than waiting for direction.
* Partner with others involved in technology delivery, adoption and change.


**Collaboration \& Ways of Working**
* Collaborates across C\&I, Enablement and Tech, Regions and broader functional teams.
* Builds strong, trusted working relationships to enable pace, alignment and clean handover to BAU.


**Job Requirements**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification.


**Experience**
* 8–12 years’ professional experience, ideally within consulting, professional services or complex enterprise environments.
* Experience of account management, client excellence, sales or growth agendas is desirable, providing context for effective technology design and adoption.
* Proven experience in gathering feedback from key stakeholders, prioritization and change adoption in supporting technology\-enabled initiatives
* Demonstrated experience delivering complex, multi‑stakeholder programs in a global, matrixed organisation.
* Experience working with business platforms and tools such as account platforms, Account LENS, EY CRM, dashboards, workflow automation or data‑driven reporting solutions.
* Strong capability in translating business, account or commercial needs into high level requirements, working closely with digital or technology enablement teams.
* Experience driving process automation, data quality and insight generation to support leadership decision making.
* Understanding of account governance, investment management or portfolio oversight and the role technology plays in enabling transparency and discipline.


**Other Requirements**
* Flexibility to work across multiple time zones.
* Occasional travel may be required.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Global Product Senior Specialist - FDP 360 Platform
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a
 **Product Analyst** 
 on the Business Intelligence \& Analytics Change Team, you will help integrate new Finance applications and analytical capabilities into BCG’s enterprise data warehouse and digital products, partnering with Business Intelligence \& Analytics Change Team subject matter experts to understand business needs, reporting requirements, and the capabilities needed to support effective decision\-making.
   

  

 Once requirements are defined, you will work closely with Solution Architects and Developers and independently lead implementation through design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. A key part of your role will be testing and validating data in Snowflake and BI reports to ensure solutions meet defined business and reporting requirements.
   

  

**Responsibilities Would Include**
* Partner with SMEs to gather, clarify, and document business and reporting requirements.
* Translate business requirements into technical requirements, data needs, and implementation plans.
* Lead implementation with Solution Architects and Developers, coordinating work through delivery.
* Analyze gaps between required analytical capabilities and Finance application data models.
* Develop and recommend solution options for review and decision by the Product Owner and SMEs.
* Define source\-to\-target data mappings and models that support scalable analysis and reporting.
* Test and validate data in Snowflake and BI reports, identifying discrepancies and ensuring solutions meet defined requirements.
* Analyze data anomalies and gaps in business logic, determine root causes, and coordinate resolution of BI reporting issues through the ServiceNow ticketing system.
* Support global users and partner with technical teams to troubleshoot and resolve data and reporting issues.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 3–5 years of experience in business intelligence, Finance reporting, data analytics, or related work.
* Hands\-on Snowflake experience querying, analyzing, testing, and validating data.
* Experience with SAP BusinessObjects or comparable enterprise BI and reporting solutions.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to analyze complex data issues, identify root causes, and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience translating business requirements into technical requirements and working with technical teams through implementation.
* Clear communication and collaboration skills for working effectively across global, cross\-functional teams.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 As a member of the Business Intelligence \& Analytics Change Team, you will work closely with the Product Owner and subject matter experts to understand business and reporting needs, partnering with Solution Architects and Developers to translate those needs into scalable data and reporting solutions. You will also collaborate with Finance teams, Finance application owners, other Business Intelligence \& Analytics teams, and global end users. As BCG’s BI environment evolves, you will work across existing SAP BusinessObjects reporting and emerging platforms, including Power BI and Sigma.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

*"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."*
 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Product Engineer (Founding Team), RAYY
description:
**Gurugram, hybrid · Full\-time · 3–5 years · Start 1 October 2026 · Immediate joiners preferred** 




  





**﻿
 
 About RAYY** 




 RAYY is a booking marketplace for sports academies, fitness classes and kids' learning
 



 activities, live in Gurugram and expanding to a second city. We are a small, fast\-moving team
 



 raising our first institutional round, and we are bringing engineering in\-house now.
 



**The role** 




 You will be one of the first two engineers at RAYY, working directly with the CPTO. The product
 



 is a Flutter customer app, a FastAPI backend on MongoDB, and Next.js dashboards for partners
 



 and our own team, on AWS. You will work end to end across all of it rather than in one layer.
 



 There is a full roadmap of customer\-facing features shipping this quarter, a backlog to clear,
 



 and releases to take over from our vendor; you will be building from day one and helping set
 



 how we build as the team grows.
 



**What you'll do** 




 Own features from API to screen across Flutter, Python and TypeScript. Fix, refactor and extend
 



 code you did not write. Ship to the Play Store and App Store and keep production healthy. Use
 



 AI coding tools as a normal part of your work, and review what they produce with the same
 



 care as your own. Write tests where they matter, especially anywhere money moves.
 



**What we're looking for** 




 Three to five years at a product company, with at least one consumer app shipped to real
 



 users; payments or marketplace experience is a plus. Working ability in at least two of Flutter,
 



 Python and TypeScript, and the willingness to work in all three. Familiarity with MongoDB, a
 



 payment gateway such as Razorpay, and AWS basics. Comfort with small teams and
 



 ambiguity: you would rather ship and learn than wait for a spec. Clear communication, since
 



 you will talk to partners and the CEO, not only to engineers. Available to start on or around 1
 



 October.
 



**Nice to have** 




 Experience at a food, fitness or booking marketplace. Prior work taking over a codebase from
 



 an agency or vendor. Flutter release tooling or Next.js.
 



**How we work** 




 Five\-day week, hybrid from our Gurugram office, with flexibility around business needs during
 



 launches and our fundraise. Small PRs, fast reviews, outcomes over hours. You will be judged
 



 on what ships and whether it stays up.
 



**Compensation** 




 Fixed salary, competitive for stage and experience.
 



**Process** 




 A short call with the CPTO, a two\-hour take\-home on our stack (use whatever tools you like; we
 



 discuss the diff together), and a conversation with the CEO. The whole loop fits in five days,
 



 and we can start you within a week of offer.
 



**To apply** 




 Send a CV or LinkedIn profile and a link to something you've shipped to hr@rayy.io with
 



 "Product Engineer" in the subject line.

title: Implementation Team Lead
description:
**Team Lead, Implementation** 




*Cvent Implementation Team \| Full\-Time\| People\-Leadership Role \|AI\-Augmented* 




  





**About the Team** 




 The Cvent Implementation team configures and deploys Cvent software for new and existing clients. Our mission is to provide expert guidance and hands\-on technical execution so every client successfully launches, adopts, and realizes value from their Cvent products.
 



 The work blends project management, technical configuration, and client\-facing consulting — and increasingly, the smart use of AI tools to move faster, reduce manual work, and deliver a sharper, more consultative client experience. As a Team Lead, you own the performance, growth, and delivery economics of a pod of Implementation Consultants operating in exactly this environment.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As Team Lead, Implementation, you lead a pod of Implementation Consultants and Senior Implementation Consultants — accountable for their delivery quality, client outcomes, professional growth, and the financial performance of your pod's portfolio. You operate as a player\-coach: close enough to projects to unblock complex escalations and guarantee delivery standards, while owning the coaching, capability\-building, and pod\-level P\&L that turn a group of strong ICs into a high\-performing, predictable delivery team.
 



 You are the first line of business accountability for delivery economics and the first line of client governance, running business reviews at the pod and skip\-level, and mentoring your team on AI\-first ways of working.
 



  





**Recruitment Scam Notice:** 
 Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “name@cvent.com” email addresses. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.
 



 If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.
 



 For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice: https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**People Leadership \& Coaching** 



* Lead, coach, and develop a pod of Implementation Consultants and Senior Implementation Consultants, owning their performance, growth, and engagement end\-to\-end.
* Run structured weekly or bi\-weekly 1:1s (more frequent for new hires) focused on project coaching, skill development, and career progression — not just status updates.
* Conduct at least one live coaching/feedback client call per direct report per month, using real client interactions as the basis for targeted development.
* Write and conduct mid\-year and annual performance reviews; build and execute individual development and ramp plans; actively manage under\-performance and grow bench strength.
* Own new\-hire onboarding and ramp for the pod — ensure training is completed thoroughly and new hires reach productivity on plan.
* Balance and monitor individual workloads across the pod, reallocating capacity to protect delivery quality and prevent burnout.



  





**Delivery \& Financial Ownership (P\&L)** 



* **Own the P\&L for your pod's project portfolio** 
 — accountable for utilization, burn rate, project profitability, cost\-to\-serve, and gross margin at the pod level, and take corrective action where performance drifts.
* Manage the health of all projects across the pod — timeliness of deliverables, quality of client deliverables, scope adherence, customer satisfaction, and portfolio risk.
* Track time and profitability across engagements and drive recommendations on streamlining, automation, or process redesign to improve delivery economics.
* Enforce SOP and quality compliance across all client\-facing deliverables — workflow diagrams, MRFs, AM templates, step\-by\-step guides, and configuration output — ensuring consistent, high\-quality material leaves the pod.
* Own escalation management for all direct reports and projects: course\-correct, put action plans in place, and mitigate delivery and relationship risk before it reaches leadership.



  





**Client Governance \& Business Reviews** 



* **Conduct Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews (MBRs / QBRs)**

 , leading client\-facing delivery or implementation teams.

**AI \& Technology Fluency** 



* Hands\-on, practical experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to accelerate delivery work, and the ability to coach others in doing the same.

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.

**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts

title: CSP - Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence & Retention
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Job Type: Permanent
   

  

 Application Deadline: 31 October 2026
   

  

**Title** 
**CSP \- Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence \& Retention**
**Department** 
**Client Servicing Platforms**
**Location** 
**Gurgaon**
**Reports To** 
**Head of Client Servicing Platforms**
**Level** 
**8**
 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our Client Servicing Platform team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
   

  

**About Your Team**
 As a business, we are constantly evolving how we work to stay ahead of what our clients need and to deliver on our Forward 8 ambitions. FIL Platforms represents the next step in that journey \- bringing together Asset Management Delivery, Enterprise Technology Services, and delivery and change teams from across the business into a single integrated structure, designed for clarity, speed, and impact.
   

  

 That structure is organised around Platforms, each a focused unit of capability with a single accountable owner and within each Platform, a set of Value Streams that translate strategic priorities into funded, sequenced delivery.
   

  

 Your value stream sits at the heart of that model. It exists to connect our talent and expertise directly to the priorities that matter most, delivering value for our clients with less duplication and fewer competing backlogs
   

  

 Client Servicing Platform is accountable for delivering on Fidelity’s client commitments after engagement, ensuring servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent and scalable across regions. The team owns the end\-to\-end client servicing journey, focusing on standardisation, transparency and repeatable delivery.
   

  

 The Service \& Retain value stream owns the platform capabilities that strengthen service performance and deepen long\-term client relationships. It brings together live service stability, continuous improvement, client insight and relationship\-focused outcomes so that service delivery is transparent, repeatable and aligned to client needs across regions.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 A value stream is FIL's core delivery construct \- the unit through which strategy becomes execution. Each value stream is underpinned by a clear roadmap, supported by the right people and capabilities required to deliver it. It sits below the Platform and above the Agile Release Train (ARTs) and Squads that do the work, and it is the layer where sequencing is decided, scope is defined and refined, and outcomes are owned.
   

  

 As a Value Stream Owner you represent the voice of the customer \- translating their strategic needs into delivery, as well as the Platform priorities.
   

  

 You will lead across both run (e.g. live service performance and stability) and change (e.g. delivery and continuous improvement). You’ll enable your teams to focus on the work that makes the biggest difference to FIL and its clients.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Client Servicing Platforms, you will lead the Service \& Retain value stream, ensuring Fidelity’s client servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent, scalable and continually improving across the end\-to\-end client journey.
   

  

 Key outcomes
   

  

* Reliable, consistent and scalable servicing outcomes across the end\-to\-end client servicing journey.
* A coherent roadmap across the Strengthen Service and Deepen Relationships ARTs, linked to platform OKRs and client value.
* Clear ownership of service stability, operational risk, client insight and continuous optimisation.
* Transparent performance tracking focused on service quality, client retention, engagement, cost\-to\-serve and platform effectiveness.


 Day to day, this means:
   

  

* Setting and defining the value stream vision (Objective \& Key Results) and roadmap, keeping it aligned to platform OKRs and FIL's Forward 8 priorities as both evolve with a focus on continuously delivering incremental value at all times.
* Acting as Value Stream Owner within the LPM process, accepting agreed demand into the backlog and leading delivery through the quarterly planning and execution cycle.
* Owning the Initiative backlog, and development of the Lean Business Case and making sequencing decisions.
* Managing the value stream budget and headcount within allocated funding levels, and making the case for investment where it is needed.
* Tracking and reporting on outcomes, not just delivery progress \- knowing what has actually moved and being honest when it has not.
* Leading Quarterly Planning Cycles and ensuring the ARTs are co\-ordinating a coherent, well\-sequenced plan.
* Managing operational risk and service stability within the value stream alongside the change agenda.
* Building and developing the leadership team within the value stream, and holding them accountable to outcomes.
* Accountable for role modelling and championing the correct behaviours and change culture.
* Championing and driving the value stream at the relevant governance forums and with senior stakeholders.
* Transiting the value stream to the North Star view over time (reducing dependencies and additional coordination horizontal layers).


**About You**
 This role will suit if you’ve run, changed and owned a large, complex global product (including service, platform, proposition or product) at scale, including: the viability, the operational, the technical, and value dimensions.
   

  

**Specifically, we are looking for:**
* Commercial acumen to own a business outcome and make the value case for a value stream's priorities.
* A genuine track record of building high\-performing, engaged teams to move the dial on performance metrics via the value delivered.
* An individual who has led both run and change, and are comfortable being fully accountable for live performance, delivery outcomes, operational effectiveness and the long\-term health of a value stream.
* An individual who can engage senior stakeholders with integrity, using sound judgement and negotiation skills to influence outcomes, manage competing interests and ensuring the right initiatives are being delivered in the right way.
* Strong familiarity with Agile operating models at scale; experience with SAFe or a comparable framework is an advantage.
* Financial management experience \- owning a budget, making trade\-offs, and being accountable for spend against outcomes.
* The technical fluency to engage meaningfully with engineering leads on architecture, debt, and delivery risk.
* Sound judgement in complex, regulated environments, balancing experience, delivery feasibility, risk, control and operational practicality without losing momentum.
* The ability to define the longer\-term direction for a value stream while staying close enough to execution, risk, delivery and operational detail to ensure results are actually achieved.
* An excellent communicator who can motivate and align large teams (including matrixed roles), create shared understanding across complex stakeholder groups and maintain momentum through clarity, consistency and presence.
* Enterprise\-first individual, supporting the creation of common, reusable patterns and repeatable solutions that improve consistency, speed and simplicity across the platforms.


 Behavioural expectations
   

  

**Brave**
* Prioritise learning and momentum over defending legacy commitments.
* Remove blockers and reset priorities when outcomes are at risk.
* Role model stopping or reshaping work that no longer delivers value.


**Bold**
* Set clear, outcome led direction and make decisive tradeoffs at valuestream level.
* Simplify governance, roles and interfaces to reduce duplication and escalation.
* Delegate real decision authority and protect teams’ ability to move at pace.


**Curious**
* Drive continuous prioritisation based on flow, outcomes and data.
* Expect evidence led conversations (not status updates) in the appropriate governance forums.
* Use delivery data to inform funding, sequencing and capacity decisions.


**Compassionate**
* Act as a visible advocate for client outcomes across the value stream.
* Build psychological safety so issues are raised early rather than escalated late.
* Balance pace with sustainability and colleague wellbeing.


 Feel rewarded
   

  

 For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.
   

  

 For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 11 to 13\+ years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day\-to\-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge \& ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)


**Work Timings\***
 11:30 am to 8:30 pm
   

  

**Job Location\***
 Gurugram/Mumbai

 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Agile Process Coaching.
* This position is based at our Gurugram office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and 30,000\+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection. Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
 



  





**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future** 




 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
 



  





 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
 



  





***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “name@cvent.com” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.* 









*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.* 









*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice. https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud.* 




  





 The Scrum Master at Cvent (SM) facilitates processes, escalates impediments, manages risk, and helps to drive continuous improvement at the team level. The scrum master acts as a servant leader to the team and promotes scrum best practices and coaches the team to track and constantly improves its velocity. The Scrum Master is expected to handle 2\-3 Sprint teams as a Scrum Master.
 



  





**Position Duties** 



* Helps to establish sprint cadence.
* Coordinates with product owners to keep the sprint team’s backlog ready and groomed.
* Facilitates sprint planning, review, daily scrum, refinement meetings, and retrospective events at the team level.
* Publishes committed sprint objectives.
* Identifies and escalates impediments.
* Manage team or project level risks and issues and take corrective actions to mitigate them, develop mitigation strategies and support the teams in addressing challenges.
* Maintains relevant metrics to help the team monitor their performance.
* Coordinates elements of the sprint plan with other technology staff outside of the project.
* Take responsibility for managing dependencies within the sprint team as well as those dependencies from other development or operations teams.
* Participates as well as facilitate Scrum of Scrums.
* Encourages Architect, UX, QT and Sprint team collaboration.
* Coordinates timely response and support to production line customer issues and helps to ensure that team maintains adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLA).
* Facilitate Project / Epic estimation process.
* Identify and promote opportunities for integrating AI tools and automation into team processes for improved efficiency (e.g., backlog refinement, reporting, estimation, or retrospective analysis).
* Documentation and Reporting: Maintain project documentation such as sprint plans, burndown charts, and crucial project documents like the Risk Register and Project Charter. Provide regular updates on project progress to stakeholders.
* Stakeholder Communication: Serve as a key point of contact for stakeholders regarding project progress and deliverables, ensuring they are informed and engaged throughout the project lifecycle.
* Actively encourage and guide the team in applying AI\-driven insights to optimize workflows, improve sprint predictability, and address bottlenecks.
* Communicates sprint/team or project status to stakeholders at a fixed cadence.
* Coordinate work teams consisting of R\&D / SRE / Cloud Operations / blended teams using agile methodologies.
* Promotes adherence to Agile software development best practices.
* Ensure team members have the necessary resources to complete their tasks.
* Ensure that sprint team deliverables meet the required quality standards.
* Drives continuous improvement initiatives at the team level.
* Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to identify and resolve issues.
* Acts as an Agile coach to the development team.



  





**What we are looking for:** 



* 4\-7 years of technical experience including 2\-5 years of experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach.
* Understanding backlog tracking, burn down metrics, velocity, task definition, and other Agile terminology.
* Large/enterprise application development experience using Agile methodologies preferred but not required.
* Strong leadership, time management, conflict resolution, and analytical skills.
* Able to act as servant leader at the team level or project level.
* Situational Awareness \- Must be the first to notice differences and issues as they arise, make all necessary attempts to solve them before elevating them to management.
* Drive for continuous improvement.
* Quick learner \- Must be able to quickly gain high level understanding of the technical and business domains of the development team.
* Familiarity with modern AI\-powered productivity and collaboration tools (e.g., AI meeting assistants, reporting bots, AI Agents, Glean, backlog analyzers etc.) is a must have.
* Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to experiment with AI\-driven solutions for workflow improvement.
* Self\-motivation and the ability to work under minimal supervision are a must.
* Outstanding written and oral communication.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Knowledge of project management methodologies, tools, and techniques will be an added advantage.
* Experience with Atlassian Tools such as Jira and Confluence preferred but not required.
* Experience and knowledge of PI planning will be an added advantage.
* Experience in project management will be an added advantage.

With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca\-Cola, Meijer, Procter \& Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.

title: Engineering Manager (Passkeys)
description:
**Engineering Manager, Passkeys**
 Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
   

  

**About the Role**
 As we establish our India Engineering Center of Excellence (COE), we are looking for an experienced
 **Engineering Manager** 
 who can lead and grow the Passkeys team. You will build the technology taking the world beyond passwords. Bitwarden is a credential provider across browser, desktop, and mobile, and the Passkeys team owns our implementation of WebAuthn and FIDO2 — creating and asserting credentials, integrating with each platform's credential provider APIs, and the emerging standards for moving credentials between providers so that users are never locked in.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Hire, develop, and retain a strong team of engineers
* Set and report on measurable goals and objectives for the team
* Facilitate team ceremonies including weekly syncs, backlog refinements, retrospectives, and sprint planning
* Monitor in\-flight work to identify blocked items, proactively drive resolution, and provide contextual updates outside of the team to the rest of the organization
* Own escalation and triage for production issues, community\-reported bugs, and enterprise customer escalations related to autofill behavior and desktop integrations
* Maintain a healthy, sprint\-ready backlog by prioritizing bugs and tech debt alongside feature work and ensuring all items are well\-defined with accurate descriptions, technical breakdowns, and designs prior to refinement
* Serve as the primary liaison between your engineering team and Design, Product, Architecture, and other engineering teams, fielding cross\-functional questions and maintaining alignment on priorities
* Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to synthesize requests into prioritized, actionable work
* Continuously identify friction points in team processes and develop solutions to improve efficiency, quality, and developer experience
* Create an inclusive environment where teamwork and collaboration are valued
* Conduct regular 1:1s, develop individualized performance goals and growth plans, and identify stretch opportunities to support each engineer's career progression
* Perform annual or semi\-annual performance reviews when required


**What You'll Bring**
* 10\-12 years of demonstrated experience leading engineering teams or complex cross\-functional product engineering initiatives within a software engineering organization.
* Experience working in globally distributed Product Engineering, GCC, or Center of Excellence environments along with managing distributed or cross\-regional teams, including working across time zones.
* Proven ability to successfully lead delivery across engineering organizations and influence multiple stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Agile software development, modern engineering practices, and product delivery lifecycles.
* Experience in Engineering Management, Technical Program Management, Engineering Delivery, Product Operations, Design Program Management, or similar leadership roles.
* Ability to communicate effectively with Engineering, Product, Design, and executive stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving, prioritization, and decision\-making skills with a continuous improvement mindset.
* A coaching\-oriented leadership style with demonstrated experience developing high\-performing teams.
* Strong technical background in CI/CD, automation \& release engineering \- sufficient to engage credibly in technical discussions and step in hands\-on when necessary.
* Excellent communication skills, with experience representing a team's work to leadership and stakeholders outside the team.
* Prior experience managing or working closely with BRE, SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering teams.
* Formal management training or certifications preferred.
* Experience with specific tools like Jira, Confluence, or similar project management platforms preferred with AI tooling for development and workflow support (Claude Code or similar).


**Success in This Role**
 You'll thrive in this position if you:
   

  

* Lead through influence, collaboration, and trust.
* Bring structure without introducing unnecessary processes.
* Balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Create clarity across complex, cross\-functional initiatives.
* Enjoy building teams, developing people, and enabling engineering excellence.
* Are energized by helping establish and scale a world\-class Engineering organization.


**Why Join Us**
 This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up.
   

  

 Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
   

  

 Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization \& contribute to products used by customers around the world.
   

  

 If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast\-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Engineering Manager (Web Platform)
description:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
   

  

**About the Role**
 As we establish our India Engineering Center of Excellence (COE), we are looking for an experienced
 **Engineering Manager** 
 who can lead and grow the Web Platform team. As the Engineering Manager for the Web Platform team, you will be expected to lead a team of experienced software engineers responsible for the core web application tooling and client services that support all of our web\-based clients. This includes our web application, Electron\-based desktop client, browser extension, and CLI, as well as other clients and additional Products in the future. You will be expected to work closely with other managers and teams across the organization to understand their needs for ongoing feature development, anticipate future needs, and ensure the ongoing stability and security of the platforms.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Hire, develop, and retain a strong team of engineers
* Set and report on measurable goals and objectives for the team
* Facilitate team ceremonies including weekly syncs, backlog refinements, retrospectives, and sprint planning
* Monitor in\-flight work to identify blocked items, proactively drive resolution, and provide contextual updates outside of the team to the rest of the organization
* Own escalation and triage for production issues, community\-reported bugs, and enterprise customer escalations related to autofill behavior and desktop integrations
* Maintain a healthy, sprint\-ready backlog by prioritizing bugs and tech debt alongside feature work and ensuring all items are well\-defined with accurate descriptions, technical breakdowns, and designs prior to refinement
* Serve as the primary liaison between your engineering team and Design, Product, Architecture, and other engineering teams, fielding cross\-functional questions and maintaining alignment on priorities
* Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to synthesize requests into prioritized, actionable work
* Continuously identify friction points in team processes and develop solutions to improve efficiency, quality, and developer experience
* Create an inclusive environment where teamwork and collaboration are valued
* Conduct regular 1:1s, develop individualized performance goals and growth plans, and identify stretch opportunities to support each engineer's career progression
* Perform annual or semi\-annual performance reviews when required


**What You'll Bring**
* 10\-12 years of demonstrated experience leading engineering teams or complex cross\-functional product engineering initiatives within a software engineering organization.
* Experience working in globally distributed Product Engineering, GCC, or Center of Excellence environments along with managing distributed or cross\-regional teams, including working across time zones.
* Proven ability to successfully lead delivery across engineering organizations and influence multiple stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Agile software development, modern engineering practices, and product delivery lifecycles.
* Experience in Engineering Management, Technical Program Management, Engineering Delivery, Product Operations, Design Program Management, or similar leadership roles.
* Ability to communicate effectively with Engineering, Product, Design, and executive stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving, prioritization, and decision\-making skills with a continuous improvement mindset.
* A coaching\-oriented leadership style with demonstrated experience developing high\-performing teams.
* Strong technical background in CI/CD, automation \& release engineering \- sufficient to engage credibly in technical discussions and step in hands\-on when necessary.
* Excellent communication skills, with experience representing a team's work to leadership and stakeholders outside the team.
* Prior experience managing or working closely with BRE, SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering teams.
* Formal management training or certifications preferred.
* Experience with specific tools like Jira, Confluence, or similar project management platforms preferred with AI tooling for development and workflow support (Claude Code or similar).


**Success in This Role**
 You'll thrive in this position if you:
   

  

* Lead through influence, collaboration, and trust.
* Bring structure without introducing unnecessary processes.
* Balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Create clarity across complex, cross\-functional initiatives.
* Enjoy building teams, developing people, and enabling engineering excellence.
* Are energized by helping establish and scale a world\-class Engineering organization.


**Why Join Us**
 This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up.
   

  

 Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
   

  

 Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization \& contribute to products used by customers around the world.
   

  

 If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast\-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

title: Global Product Senior Analyst
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 The HR Digital Product Portfolio is one of the largest and most dynamic portfolios within BCG’s Digital Products Organization, enabling technology across BCG’s HR and People functions. Within the Talent Acquisition Product Team, the Candidate Selection squad supports the products and capabilities that underpin how BCG assesses and selects candidates.
   

  

 As a Senior Product Analyst, you will work closely with the Product Owner, business teams, technology teams, QA, and external vendors to shape effective product solutions. You will independently explore business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate complex requirements into clear, actionable solutions, with the Product Owner providing direction and final sign\-off where appropriate.
   

  

* Lead and facilitate requirements discussions with business and technology teams to understand problems, user needs, business value, and the wider impact of proposed changes.
* Document clear product requirements in Jira, translating business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, use cases, and solution options.
* Challenge requests constructively, identifying assumptions, dependencies, risks, unintended consequences, and alternative approaches before solutions are agreed.
* Co\-create solutions with business, technology, QA, and vendor teams, helping bridge functional and technical considerations and supporting the Product Owner with prioritization and delivery readiness.
* Build deep product knowledge and take accountability for changes from requirements through test\-scenario definition, validation, deployment readiness, and rollout.
* Prioritize and investigate assigned production issues, identify likely root causes, and bring the right squad, vendor, or technology expertise together to drive effective resolution.
* Support successful adoption of new functionality by preparing release notes and partnering with Learning and Development and Process Enablement colleagues on user guidance and learning materials where needed.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives and broader Talent Acquisition Product Team priorities as opportunities and business needs evolve.
* Build adjacent product and technical skills, including taking on straightforward SaaS configuration and functional enhancement activities where appropriate.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 4\+ years of relevant experience in product analysis, business analysis, technology, operations, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking skills, with confidence to challenge assumptions, identify downstream impacts, and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience eliciting, translating, and documenting business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, and use cases.
* Experience partnering with developers and engineers to bridge functional and technical requirements and translate business intent into implementation\-ready specifications.
* Experience partnering with QA teams to define test scenarios, validate system behaviour, investigate issues, and manage feedback through delivery.
* Experience working with SaaS products and external vendors, with an interest in developing hands\-on configuration and product administration capabilities.
* Strong working knowledge of Jira and Confluence; Talent Acquisition or HR technology experience is strongly preferred, while exposure to ServiceNow, APIs, integrations, MuleSoft, production support, system troubleshooting, or change management is beneficial.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 You’ll be part of the Candidate Selection squad within BCG’s global Talent Acquisition Product Team.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate closely with Product Owners, engineers, developers, QA, Scrum Leads, SaaS Engineers, Talent Acquisition teams, and external vendors. Depending on the product or change, you may also partner with Legal, Data Protection, and Responsible AI teams.
   

  

 The team works through close business and technology co\-creation, combining BCG\-built solutions with integrated SaaS platforms and strong vendor partnerships across a global network.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
   

  

 For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
   

  

 We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

* Solid, demonstrable understanding of Agile principles and the Scrum framework.
* Proven experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and coaching delivery teams.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Effective stakeholder management across technical and business audiences.
* Ability to remove impediments and promote team self\-organisation.
* Proficiency with an Agile work\-tracking tool and delivery reporting.


**Preferred Experience**
* 3–5 years in a Scrum Master role.

* Exposure to NetSuite projects or ERP delivery.

 Tools \& Systems
   

  

* Salesforce — primary supported platform (\~90%).
* NetSuite — secondary supported platform (\~10%).

* Ceremony effectiveness: well\-facilitated, outcome\-focused Scrum events across both teams.
* Impediment resolution: blockers identified and resolved in a timely manner.
* Delivery predictability: consistent achievement of sprint commitments and stable flow.
* Cross\-platform coordination: Salesforce/NetSuite dependencies managed smoothly.
* Transparency: clear, current reporting on progress and delivery metrics.

 Agile / Scrum Master (required)
   

  

 Jira (preferred)

title: Global IT Configuration Engineer Senior Specialist
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 In a world where data is critical to BCG's success, we are building first\-class, foundational capabilities and products across the firm. Within this vision, LEAP is delivering BCG's new Learning platform to power the firm's learning and development needs.
   

  

 Initially, you’ll work within the Data Product squad to build a custom data product in Snowflake as part of a broader transformation program of BCG’s learning technology. The data product will help enable AI\-driven learning and make learning data accessible to other teams and systems, including, for example, staffing and analytics. When the program has ended, you’ll be part of a Learning squad with RtB as its scope.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include**
* Develop well\-structured Agile user stories and acceptance criteria that enable effective solution delivery, and owning your area of backlog
* Analyze processes and data needs, contributing to solution design and identifying practical approaches to business problems.
* Coordinate functional, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing to ensure solutions meet business requirements.
* Support release readiness and implementation, identifying issues and working with technical teams to resolve them.
* Elicit, document, and validate requirements by engaging multiple stakeholder groups and subject matter experts.
* Write clear, well\-structured user stories and acceptance criteria understandable by both technical and functional colleagues.
* Create, update, and maintain requirements documentation (e.g., PRDs / functional specifications).
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, anticipating questions and translating technical details into plain language.
* Manage and triage support requests in a query management system (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Proactively flag risks and dependencies, keeping learner impact and business value as the priority.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

***Education***
* Bachelor's degree required.
* 5–8 years of experience as a business / systems analyst, ideally supporting or configuring enterprise applications.


**Experience / Knowledge**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5\-7 years of experience with Learning or HR applications.
* Experience with learning management or experience platforms; Docebo experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience with data products, third\-party platforms, and SaaS technology solutions.
* Working technical fluency with Snowflake, querying databases, and querying APIs to understand and validate data.
* Strong Agile experience, including writing user stories and working with Jira, sprints, and ceremonies.
* Experience developing and executing functional, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing.
* Experience using AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of your work.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 The Business Analyst is a role within the Data Product Squad, part of LEAP in BCG's digital products organisation. Reporting to the IT Director, you will work day\-to\-day with your Product Owner, Chapter Leads, Scrum Master, and squad members, as well as functional business partners, subject matter experts, and IT colleagues. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the business to analyse, configure, and evolve BCG's new Learning platform, supporting both day\-to\-day operations and transformative change.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**You're Good At**
* Translating learning and business needs into product requirements — asking the right questions and pushing past surface\-level answers.
* Writing clear, well\-structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirements documentation.
* Communicating clearly, both verbally and in writing, with all staff levels including leadership; excellent listening skills.
* Engaging and managing stakeholders across business, functional, and IT groups, and collaborating remotely with global experts.
* Being outcome\-focused — keeping learner impact and business value front of mind.
* Owning your workstream — taking responsibility for your area of the backlog and delivery, proactively flagging risks.
* Managing data definitions and basic governance — flagging when a decision has governance implications.
* Working within an Agile framework.


*"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."*
